{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

deMULTIplex2 class distribution after QC flags have been applied.
Shows how multiplets and negatives overlap with low-quality cells,
and which cells are retained after filtering.

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
library(targets)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

```{r load}
# metadata_flagged_all contains dm2_class and pass_cell added by flag_qc_metadata().
# mpn_raw_all is pre-QC and lacks both columns — do not use it here.
targets::tar_load(metadata_flagged_all)
targets::tar_load(mpn_raw_stroma)   # needed for HTO assay in sections 5 & 6
targets::tar_load(qc_params)

md                 <- metadata_flagged_all
srt                <- mpn_raw_stroma
DM2_AVAILABLE      <- "dm2_class" %in% colnames(md)
PASSCELL_AVAILABLE <- "pass_cell" %in% colnames(md)
```

---

## 1. QC flags × HTO class cross-table

How many cells in each deMULTIplex2 class pass or fail QC?

```{r flags-crosstab}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
cross_tbl <- md |>
  dplyr::count(dm2_class, pass_qc, pass_hto, pass_cell, name = "n_cells") |>
  dplyr::mutate(pct = round(100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells), 1)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dm2_class, pass_qc)

knitr::kable(cross_tbl)
```

---

## 2. deMULTIplex2 class distribution — before vs after filtering

```{r dm2-before-after}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
before <- md |>
  dplyr::count(dm2_class, name = "n_cells") |>
  dplyr::mutate(stage = "pre-filter",
                pct   = round(100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells), 1))

after <- md |>
  dplyr::filter(pass_cell) |>
  dplyr::count(dm2_class, name = "n_cells") |>
  dplyr::mutate(stage = "post-filter",
                pct   = round(100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells), 1))

both <- dplyr::bind_rows(before, after) |>
  dplyr::mutate(stage = factor(stage, c("pre-filter", "post-filter")))

ggplot(both, aes(x = reorder(dm2_class, -n_cells), y = n_cells, fill = stage)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("pre-filter" = "#4393c3",
                                "post-filter" = "#2166ac")) +
  labs(title = "deMULTIplex2 class distribution before and after QC filtering",
       x = NULL, y = "# cells", fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

---

## 3. QC metrics by HTO class

Do multiplets or negatives show distinct QC metric distributions?

```{r qc-by-class}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
#| fig-height: 8
qc_vars <- c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.rp")

plots <- list()
for (v in qc_vars) {
  plots[[v]] <- ggplot(md, aes(x = dm2_class, y = .data[[v]], fill = dm2_class)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.size = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = v) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
}
wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2)
```

---

## 4. pass_cell distribution per sample

How many cells per sample survive all filters?

```{r pass-cell-per-sample}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("PASSCELL_AVAILABLE"))
sample_tbl <- md |>
  dplyr::group_by(sample.name) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total    = dplyr::n(),
    n_pass     = sum(pass_cell),
    pct_pass   = round(100 * n_pass / n_total, 1),
    n_fail_qc  = sum(!pass_qc),
    n_fail_hto = sum(pass_qc & !pass_hto),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(sample_tbl,
             col.names = c("Sample", "Total", "Pass", "% pass",
                           "Fail QC", "Fail HTO (pass QC)"))

ggplot(sample_tbl, aes(x = sample.name, y = n_pass)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct_pass, "%")), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Cells passing all filters per sample",
       x = NULL, y = "# cells") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```

---

## 5. HTO signal in pass vs fail cells

Do failed cells show lower HTO signal overall?

```{r hto-signal-pass-fail}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
hto_df        <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(
  SeuratObject::LayerData(srt, assay = "HTO", layer = "data"))))
hto_df$total     <- rowSums(hto_df)
hto_df$pass_cell <- md[rownames(hto_df), "pass_cell"]

ggplot(hto_df, aes(x = pass_cell, y = total, fill = pass_cell)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("FALSE" = "Fail", "TRUE" = "Pass")) +
  labs(title = "Total CLR-normalised HTO signal: pass vs fail cells",
       x = NULL, y = "Sum of CLR HTO signal") +
  theme_bw()
```

---

## 6. HTO signal heatmap — pass_cell only

```{r hto-heatmap-filtered}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(get0("DM2_AVAILABLE"))
#| fig-height: 5
pass_cells <- rownames(md)[md$pass_cell]
srt_pass <- subset(srt, cells = intersect(colnames(srt), pass_cells))
srt_pass  <- Seurat::NormalizeData(srt_pass, assay = "HTO",
                                    normalization.method = "CLR",
                                    margin = 2, verbose = FALSE)
avg <- Seurat::AverageExpression(srt_pass, assay = "HTO",
                                  layer    = "data",
                                  group.by = "dm2_class")$HTO
avg_df <- as.data.frame(avg) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("HTO") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-HTO, names_to = "class", values_to = "avg_clr")

ggplot(avg_df, aes(x = class, y = HTO, fill = avg_clr)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_clr, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "white", high = "firebrick",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "Avg CLR") +
  labs(title = "Mean HTO signal per class (post-filter cells only)",
       x = "Assigned class", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```
